desc: CCI understands what shooters want and need, especially when it comes to this high velocity 22 Short cartridge useful for plinking, target, and competition shooting! Blanks are an ideal option for shooters interested in hunting dog training, starter pistols or at those times when there is need for noise but no need for a live round. Loaded with only clean burning propellant, blank ammo is a phenomenal option for any firearm chambered for 22 Short, 22 Long or 22 Long Rifle.
